map.土壤有机质含量（烧失法）估算 使用指南: Soil organic matter content (loss-on-ignition) estimation user guide
map.输入坩埚空重、灼烧前与灼烧后的干土重量，按烧失量LOI估算土壤有机质与有机碳含量: Input crucible tare and pre-/post-incineration dry-soil weights; estimate soil organic matter and organic carbon by loss-on-ignition LOI, for lab quick assessment of arable fertility and humus level.
map.烧失量 LOI = (烧前总重 − 烧后总重) ÷ 烧前干土净重 × 100%；: LOI = (pre-burn total weight - post-burn total weight) / pre-burn dry-soil net weight x 100%; pre-burn dry-soil net weight = pre-burn total weight - crucible tare; organic carbon = LOI x 0.58
map.与烧失法同源：先扣除坩埚空重得烧前干土净重，再以「(烧前总重 − 烧后总重) ÷: Same origin as loss-on-ignition: first subtract the crucible tare to get pre-burn dry-soil net weight, then "LOI = (pre-burn total weight - post-burn total weight) / dry-soil net weight x 100%" gives the loss on ignition LOI, i.e. an approximation of organic matter content; organic carbon = organic matter x 0.58. Evaluate arable fertility by organic matter bands (extremely low < 1%, low < 2%, medium < 3%, fairly high < 5%, high >= 5%).
map.填写「烧前总重（坩埚+干土）g」。: Fill in "pre-burn total weight (crucible + dry soil) g".
map.填写「烧后总重（坩埚+灰分）g」。: Fill in "post-burn total weight (crucible + ash) g".
map.有机质 ≈ 烧失量 / 土样干重（经验换算，非直接等于）。: Organic matter approx loss-on-ignition / dry soil sample weight (empirical conversion, not directly equal).
map.重铬酸钾氧化法是更准的化学测定。: Potassium dichromate oxidation is a more accurate chemical determination.
map.用于耕地质量监测与培肥效果评价。: For arable-quality monitoring and fertilization-effect evaluation.
map.：风干土 5.000 g 灼烧后剩 4.320 g，烧失 0.680 g。粗略有: : air-dry soil 5.000 g incinerated leaves 4.320 g, loss 0.680 g. Rough organic matter approx organic part of loss, by experience organic matter approx 0.68/5 x factor approx 13.6% (high, need potassium dichromate correction; incineration includes bound-water error).
map.连作障碍指数（土壤病原菌积累）估算: Continuous-cropping obstacle index (soil pathogen accumulation) estimation
map.只能估算，因为灼烧同时失去结合水与碳酸盐，高估有机质。科研与测土配方以重铬酸钾氧: It can only be estimated, because incineration also loses bound water and carbonate, overestimating organic matter. Research and soil-testing use potassium dichromate oxidation-external heating as standard; loss-on-ignition is for quick rough judgment.
map.有机质多少算好地？: How much organic matter is good soil?
map.耕地有机质 2% 以下偏瘦、2%~4% 良好、高于 4% 很肥沃（依土类）。提升: Arable organic matter below 2% is lean, 2%-4% good, above 4% very fertile (by soil type). Improve by straw return, organic fertilizer and green manure; it is a slow variable.
